paper_title: Axion Dark Matter from Cosmic String Network
notes: This is a theoretical/cosmological lattice-simulation paper estimating axion dark matter abundance radiated from global cosmic strings in the post-inflationary scenario. It derives a conservative LOWER BOUND on the QCD axion mass (upper bound on f_a), not an experimental exclusion limit or coupling constraint. The provided excerpt does not contain the explicit numerical value of the derived lower bound (uses xi_star=13.4/16.6, log_star~64-70, Omega_a h^2~0.12(28ueV/m_a)^7/6 reference), so no reliable (mass, coupling) data points can be extracted. Not a haloscope/DM-search coupling limit; no local DM density applies. Not a coupling-constant exclusion plot, so treated as AxionMass hint but with no extractable data. | [CONVENTION REVIEW] declared coupling convention 'm_a in eV (lower bound only)' is not canonical and has no vetted auto-conversion; needs human review
